text:
Sofia M: FYI OrchidFin asked for our compliance bundle to complete procurement: redacted SOC2, ISO cert, signed pen-test attestation, network diagram, and confirmation of KMS/BYOK for Dedicated. They also want a short PS quote for the network runbook + connector setup. Can we pull together by Tue?

Tom W: For pen-test attestation procurement requires: vendor name, date of test (within 12 months), and a one-paragraph scope. We have a standard attestation but Legal needs to add signature. @Aisha R can Legal sign and backdate if needed?

Aisha R: Legal cannot backdate. We can sign the attestation referencing the latest test date if the vendor scan is within 12 months. If not, we can provide the attestation plus an explanation and timeline for a supplemental scan. Also: procurement sometimes insists on a notarized letter; that's rare but flagging it.

Liam D: KMS note: for Dedicated customers we support customer-managed keys via KMS or HSM. Theres a one-time integration and network ACL work. If they need HSM on-prem we treat that as a custom engineering engagement.

Sofia M: They specified Dedicated in the deck. Theyre leaning away from on-prem due to hardware ops.

Tom W: PS quote draft: network diagram + high-level runbook = 10hrs ($1,500), connector engineering review = 8hrs ($1,200), HSM integration scoping (if needed) = 6hrs ($900). Total placeholder = $3,600 (hourly rates applied). I'll validate with finance.

Aisha R: I'll queue the attestation for signature. We need a PO or signed SOW to attach the signed copy per process. If Sales can confirm a PO window, Legal will expedite.

Liam D: I'll draft the KMS architecture note and staging IP ranges. For the vulnerability scan creds: we can produce ephemeral creds scoped to a limited subnet and a scheduled maint window. Ops needs the scan start/end times.

security-bot: Compliance package build started (ticket CF-4421). Please attach artifacts to https://redwood-secure/share/orchidfin-poc.

Sofia M: Action items: @Aisha R get signed attestation once PO confirmed; @Liam D produce KMS note + staging IPs; @Tom W finalize PS quote and finance approval; I'll notify the customer that were targeting next Tue and share the secure folder link.

Tom W: One more ask from procurement: can we mark the SOC2 as "redacted" and include control owner contact? They want someone to reach out for clarifying Qs. We should add a single point of contact email.

Aisha R: OK we will redact sensitive tables and include control owner contact (security@redwood.com). Will attach SOC2 redacted PDF and ISO27001 cert.

Sofia M: Thanks team, I'll draft the customer update and post the folder contents as they arrive.
